content: Root cause: The bug was caused by an incorrect handling of the document offset when transitioning to using `AtomicReaderContext`. The original code initialized an `offset` variable to zero and then incorrectly assigned it to `off`, which was intended to represent the document base from the `readerContext`. This led to incorrect calculations of document values, as the offset was not properly reflecting the actual position of documents within the context, resulting in potential misalignment of data when retrieving float values. The patch corrected this by directly using `readerContext.docBase` as the offset, ensuring that the document values are accurately accessed.
